items.question: How is the interior level defined in relation to the lintel and the upper parts of the pillars?
premises: The interior is joined with the upper parts of the pillars.
The level is specified with respect to the lintel.
The particle tu introduces a specific qualification to the arrangement.
items.inference: The interior floor level is determined by its connection to the pillar tops and its position at the lintel.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referent of talaṃ in this context is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Inside, joined with the upper parts of the pillars, the level is defined with respect to the lintel.
